study: Taylor et al. 2015 (BSCS Inquiry Approach + curriculum-based PD; AERJ 52(5))
delivery_evidence: PD was face-to-face: a seven-day curriculum-based PD program each year composed of a three-day summer institute plus four additional days; paper repeatedly refers to 'face-to-face, curriculum-based PD' sessions (Method/PD section; '...face-to-face PD sessions complemented...').
test_alignment_evidence: Sole included student-achievement outcome is the Washington High School Proficiency Exam (HSPE), 10th-grade science -- a broad independent state assessment not tailored to the BSCS curriculum (extraction test_type=standardized_independent; p.21-23, Tables 6-7).
curriculum_evidence: Intervention bundles PD with adoption of a specific new curriculum: 'BSCS Science: An Inquiry Approach' student and teacher curriculum materials, with curriculum-based PD designed around those materials ('research-based curriculum materials with curriculum-based professional development'; Curriculum Materials section).
outcome_timing_evidence: HSPE science measured spring of Grade 10, at the end of the 2-year program (Grades 9-10); no post-intervention follow-up wave (extraction timepoint 'post, spring Grade 10'; p.21-23).
